headline: Enbridge signals interest in building the Pathways carbon-capture CO2 pipeline
summary: On its Q3 earnings, Canadian midstream major Enbridge expressed interest in building the long-haul CO2 pipeline for the Oil Sands Alliance's (formerly Pathways Alliance) proposed carbon-capture network, which would move captured oilsands CO2 from the Fort McMurray area to a storage hub near Cold Lake, Alberta (sized for ~6 Mtpa by the mid-2030s), ahead of a late-2027 FID.
co2crc_note: A credible pipeline proponent stepping forward de-risks the transport leg of a flagship oilsands CCS network; relevant to how large CO2 T&S infrastructure gets financed and operated.
extractor_note: Expression of interest only, not a committed project. 6 Mtpa is the Pathways network design capacity, not Enbridge's own commitment. Source is Enbridge Q3 earnings coverage; pipeline-interest detail from Google-Alerts sampler, WebFetch blocked so unverified.

headline: New platform standardises legacy well-integrity screening for Class VI CO2-storage permitting
summary: An SPE CCUS 2026 technical paper describes 'Wellborne', a platform for standardised screening of legacy well integrity to support US EPA Class VI (CO2 injection) well permitting, tackling a containment-risk bottleneck where old wellbores penetrating a storage complex must be assessed for leakage before a permit can proceed.
co2crc_note: Legacy-well integrity screening is a core storage-site characterisation and MMV challenge directly relevant to CO2CRC's geological-storage assurance work and to any Australian storage-permitting workflow.
extractor_note: SPE CCUS 2026 conference proceedings (technical tool/methodology), not a commercial deal. Date from Google-Alerts sampler, unverified.

headline: Gulf Cryo expands UAE industrial CCUS footprint ahead of ADIPEC 2026
summary: UAE industrial-gases group Gulf Cryo set out a broader push to expand its carbon-capture/CO2-utilisation footprint across the UAE market, timed to ADIPEC 2026, extending the single Abu Dhabi plant start-up briefed on 5 Nov into a company-wide regional-expansion strategy. A merchant-market CCU play rather than geological storage.
co2crc_note: Merchant CO2/CCU market expansion in the Gulf; peripheral to CO2CRC's geological-storage focus but a marker of CCUS commercial activity around ADIPEC.
extractor_note: CO2-utilisation/merchant-gas expansion, not geological CCS. Extends the 5 Nov Gulf Cryo single-plant item into a company-wide strategy framing. Date/detail from Google-Alerts sampler, WebFetch blocked so unverified.

headline: Global operating carbon-capture capacity on track to pass 100 Mt/yr once builds complete, report finds
summary: A new industry report finds operating CO2-capture capacity would rise about 82% to above 100 Mtpa once projects currently under construction enter service, but warns policy and financing remain the binding constraints on that pipeline actually converting to operation. A capacity-outlook read, not a discrete new commitment.
co2crc_note: Market-aggregate capacity outlook; useful context on global CCS deployment pace and the policy/financing constraints that also shape the Australian pipeline.
extractor_note: Capacity-outlook/market-aggregate figure (>100 Mtpa once under-construction projects complete), NOT a discrete commitment; capacity_mtpa is a cumulative global resource, non-additive. Date from Google-Alerts sampler, unverified; underlying report release may predate the window.
